clue.text: Forceful shot earns fortune at golf club

parts.note: a pile is a large fortune, as in making one's pile
a driver is the golf club used for long tee shots

explanation.surface: A powerful stroke wins someone a fortune at their golf club.
explanation.definitionFit: A piledriver is slang for a very hard, powerful hit or kick, a forceful shot in sport.

clue.text: At home, head of table's impolite to butt in

parts.note: in means at home, as in staying in

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter, so the opening letter of table is taken

parts.note: rude means impolite

explanation.surface: Someone at home thinks a table's leader is rude to interrupt.
explanation.definitionFit: To butt in is to interrupt or intrude on others uninvited, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Gold coin found in area, gleaming

indicators.note: the letters are found inside the run of words area gleaming

explanation.surface: A gold coin is discovered in a gleaming spot.
explanation.definitionFit: The eagle was a ten-dollar United States gold coin, minted for well over a century.

clue.text: Exceptional thing, the talking point of twitchers?

definitions.meaning: birdwatchers, called twitchers in Britain, talk most about an uncommon species sighted

explanation.surface: Something exceptional is what birdwatchers chatter about.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom for an unusual person or thing, also literally an uncommon species that excites birdwatchers.

clue.text: Out-of-state stokers, ones to be lavishly entertained at the White House?

definitions.text: ones to be lavishly entertained at the White House?

parts.note: people from out of state are visiting
firemen in the old sense tended the fires of furnaces and steam engines

explanation.surface: Fire-tenders from another state are to be wined and dined at the President's residence.
explanation.definitionFit: The American idiom names important guests given lavish hospitality on an official visit.

clue.text: Feeling regret about Left being in power

indicators.note: the regret word wraps around the letter for Left

parts.note: ruing means feeling regret

explanation.surface: Someone feels sorry about the Left holding office.
explanation.definitionFit: A ruling party is the one governing, so ruling means holding power.

clue.text: Only fair? Quite

definitions.meaning: ... means fair, as in a ... ruling
... means quite or exactly, as in ... right

explanation.surface: Is it merely reasonable? Absolutely.
explanation.definitionFit: The word carries three senses: merely, equitable, and exactly or quite.

clue.text: Strong westerlies flow behind aircraft

definitions.meaning: fast high-altitude winds blowing from the west
read literally, the stream of exhaust gas left behind a jet plane

explanation.surface: Powerful west winds rush along behind a plane.
explanation.definitionFit: The jet stream is a fast high-altitude air current that blows mainly from west to east.

clue.text: Well up about care of cat

indicators.note: the surging word goes around the abbreviation for care of

parts.note: to surge is to well up
c/o, written CO, abbreviates care of on addresses

explanation.surface: Feelings rise when looking after a cat.
explanation.definitionFit: Cat here is the cat-o'-nine-tails, a whip, and a scourge is a whip.

clue.text: Male's short leg

indicators.note: short means the word is cut by its final letter

parts.note: a stage is a leg of a journey or race

explanation.surface: A man's leg is stumpy.
explanation.definitionFit: A stag is an adult male deer, and by extension a man on his own, as at a stag party.

clue.text: Analysis concerning explanation

parts.note: re means concerning, about
a solution is the explanation of a problem

explanation.surface: A study about an explanation.
explanation.definitionFit: Resolution is the breaking down of something into its components, an analysis.

clue.text: Splendid salesman aboard coach heading west

indicators.note: in an across clue heading west means reading right to left, so the whole coach-with-salesman is turned
aboard puts the salesman inside the vehicle

parts.note: a coach is a bus
a rep, sales representative, is a salesman

explanation.surface: A great salesman rides a coach going west.
explanation.walkthrough: With the salesman sitting 'aboard' the coach the run is BREPUS; 'heading west' then turns it round, as an across answer is read westward.
explanation.definitionFit: Superb is a straightforward synonym of splendid, meaning excellent.

clue.text: Trace element, cobalt, finally detected in preserve

parts.note: tin is a chemical element

indicators.note: the final letter is found inside the preserving word

parts.note: to cure is to preserve meat or fish

indicators.note: finally takes the last letter of cobalt

explanation.surface: Lab news: a trace element, cobalt, has at last been found in a preserve.
explanation.definitionFit: A tincture is a slight trace or tinge of something.

clue.text: Read, surprisingly, about British king on German flying ace

indicators.note: the mixed letters go around the British abbreviation
surprisingly signals that the letters of read are mixed up

parts.note: R, for rex, is the abbreviation for king
taken as written

explanation.surface: Read, astonishingly, about a British king's opinion of a German pilot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'surprisingly' rearranges the first word's letters as REDA, and 'about' wraps that round B, giving REDBA before the king's letter.
explanation.definitionFit: The Red Baron was the nickname of Manfred von Richthofen, Germany's top fighter pilot in the First World War.

clue.text: Coarse, the head in plant

parts.note: broad can mean coarse or vulgar, as in broad humour
bean is slang for the head

explanation.surface: A coarse remark goes to the head in a plant.
explanation.definitionFit: The broad bean is a plant grown for its large flat edible seeds.

clue.text: Level in game cut short

indicators.note: cut short drops the final letter of the game word

parts.note: an event is a sporting contest or game

explanation.surface: A match is levelled when it is stopped early.
explanation.definitionFit: Even means level, flat or equal, as in an even score.

clue.text: Caution girl

explanation.surface: A warning about a young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Prudence is carefulness, and it is also a woman's given name.

clue.text: Gain access to computer without using name and symbol

indicators.note: the abbreviation for name is left out of the phrase

parts.note: to log on is to gain access to a computer

explanation.surface: Getting into a computer anonymously needs a symbol.
explanation.definitionFit: A logo is an emblem or symbol identifying a company.

clue.text: Pompous golfer's second round

indicators.note: second takes the second letter of golfer

parts.note: rotund means round, plump

explanation.surface: A self-important golfer has a second round.
explanation.definitionFit: Orotund describes a pompous, pretentious style of speaking.

clue.text: First and second entering wooded area

indicators.note: the moment word goes into the wooded area

parts.note: a forest is a wooded area
mo is a short moment, a second

explanation.surface: First and second runners enter a woodland.
explanation.definitionFit: Foremost means first in position or importance.

clue.text: Separate FBI agents in series

indicators.note: the agents are placed inside the series word

parts.note: a set is a series or group
G-men is a nickname for FBI agents, short for government men

explanation.surface: FBI agents are split up into a series.
explanation.definitionFit: To segment is to divide into parts, to separate.

clue.text: Certainly an Arab vessel

parts.note: a dhow is a sailing vessel of the Arabian Sea

explanation.surface: It is surely an Arab boat.
explanation.definitionFit: And how is an emphatic informal phrase meaning certainly, very much so.

clue.text: Introvert must entertain fellow city dweller

indicators.note: entertain means hold within, so the fellow goes inside

parts.note: a loner is a solitary introvert
a don is a fellow of a university

explanation.surface: A shy person must play host to another urban resident.
explanation.definitionFit: A Londoner is an inhabitant of London, a city dweller.

clue.text: Condescend to accept second plan

indicators.note: the condescending word takes in the abbreviation for second

parts.note: to deign is to condescend

explanation.surface: Someone stoops to accepting a second scheme.
explanation.definitionFit: A design is a plan or scheme, as in by design.

clue.text: Irregular bears a sword

indicators.note: irregular signals the letters of bears are put out of order

explanation.surface: An irregular soldier carries a sword.
explanation.definitionFit: A sabre is a heavy cavalry sword with a curved blade.

clue.text: Divine drink, a rum he ordered at noon

parts.note: to sup is to drink

indicators.note: ordered means arranged anew, so the letters of a rum he are rearranged

explanation.surface: A heavenly drink: a rum ordered by a man at midday.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ordered' turns A RUM HE into ERHUMA.
explanation.definitionFit: Divine in the sense of godlike, beyond human powers, is superhuman.

clue.text: Raised money, reportedly

indicators.note: reportedly means as spoken, so the slang word is said out loud

parts.note: bread is slang for money

explanation.surface: Funds were raised, so they say.
explanation.definitionFit: Bred means raised, as of children or livestock brought up.

clue.text: A cave in a Yemeni port

parts.note: a den is an animal's lair, a cave

explanation.surface: There is a cave in a port in Yemen.
explanation.definitionFit: Aden is the major port city of southern Yemen.

clue.text: Fabric shrink? Up to the present time, both ends of tie!

parts.note: to wince is to shrink back, flinch
yet means up to now, so far

indicators.note: both ends of tie means its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A fabric shrinks? So far, it has at both ends of a tie!
explanation.definitionFit: Winceyette is a soft brushed cotton fabric used for nightwear.
